moa.t: Blocks mineralocorticoid receptors in the distal nephron: sodium loss, potassium retention, reduces mortality in heart failure

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Spironolactone, oral, 25 mg daily (doctor initiated). Table 4.4: Stepwise approach of treating hypertension without compelling indications
Spironolactone, oral, 1–3 mg/kg as a single daily dose. Can increase dosage slowly to 4–6 mg/kg/day. · Continue for as long as needed to control ascites.
Spironolactone, oral, 1–3 mg/kg/dose once daily in consultation with a paediatric cardiologist. May be divided 12 hourly.

cautions.t: Hyperkalaemia risk with ACE inhibitors, ARBs, potassium supplements, NSAIDs and cotrimoxazole

adverse_effects.t: Hyperkalaemia, gynaecomastia, menstrual disturbance, acute kidney injury

monitoring.t: Potassium and creatinine at baseline, 1 week, then regularly
